quote: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized a wide range of domains, including natural language understanding and generation, as well as multimodal applications, driving significant advancements in both technology and real-world applications.

The paper evaluates model outputs on reasoning, knowledge, math, coding, instruction following, and long-context tasks using standardized benchmarks.

quote: we evaluate the model using lm-evaluation-harness following the leaderboard protocols

We extract evaluation results from the Open LLM Leaderboard v1, which provides performance metrics for open-source LLMs across six widely used benchmarks: ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA, and GSM8K.
